content:
## 先分地区和资料时间

本页依据[国服10月15日版本更新说明](https://endfield.hypergryph.com/news/6094)，10月18日核验。公告的计划维护为10月15日06:00—12:00（UTC+8），不据计划推断实际恢复时刻。国际服版本、平台资格与服务器时间须独立核对；Pioneer Test仅作历史资料。

## 进入版本先做什么

1. 完成官方客户端更新；本次为强制更新，PC端关闭游戏后重启鹰角启动器检查更新，其他平台按官方商店或客户端指引处理。
2. 检查账号资格与邮箱：更新维护和问题修复各补偿嵌晶玉×900，要求10月15日更新前创建角色，并解锁邮箱。两封邮件于下次版本维护时过期，不是所有新玩家均可领取。
3. 核对当前寻访阶段与预算，不把两个版本新干员理解为同时开放。
4. 按主线进度进入「武陵 - 祀的画」。主线开放至第二章进程Ⅷ「着新墨」，具体内容依探索进度解锁。

## 寻访与活动节点

下表均保留官方“服务器时间”口径，不统一换算为北京时间。

| 项目 | 公告窗口 | 使用注意 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 万物更新：祀 | 版本更新后—11月5日11:59 | 明河不是该阶段概率提升干员 |
| 烟火邀星河：明河 | 11月5日12:00—版本维护前 | 尚未到窗口时不称已开放 |
| 万物有灵签到 | 版本更新后—11月5日11:59 | 累计7日可得寻访凭证×5等 |
| 卡莉的芳菲童话 | 10月22日12:00—11月5日04:00 | 拍照活动；按任务领取奖励 |
| 祖泉的新流：汤汤 | 10月29日12:00—11月19日11:59 | 与版本新干员寻访分开核对 |

“篆玉申领”和“月映申领”按各自起点后的3次特许寻访计结束，不擅自填入固定截止日期。完整概率、保底和申领说明请进入客户端确认。

## 工业与系统：哪些旧攻略需要重验

- **自动农植机**：解锁后可在祀的画种植区自动育苗、收获；武陵城相关使用能力随剧情推进开放，不假设所有地点立即可用。
- **连携技优先级**：编队界面可调整，同一时点触发多个连携技时按顺序施放。旧连携循环应重新测试。
- **装备方案**：支持保存多套与自定义命名；不等于本站已有各干员最优配装。
- **舱室班组**：每间最多A/B两班，可手动启用或自动轮换；预计工时不足时仍可能中断生产。
- **到期限时理智药剂**：自动转化仍受理智上限、理智精粹药剂持有量和理智萃取器可用性约束，条件不足会销毁，不能简化为“永不浪费”。

## 资料边界

本页是官方更新整理，不是客户端实测。新干员技能倍率、材料效率、工业配方成本与地图全收集仍需当前客户端记录。旧测试攻略保留档案标签；请先使用[国服版本与活动看板](/endfield/events)，不要沿用历史报名倒计时。
contentEn:
## Scope and source

Checked October 18 against the [October 15 CN update notice](https://endfield.hypergryph.com/news/6094). Scheduled maintenance was 06:00–12:00 UTC+8; this is not proof of the actual completion time. International status and Pioneer Test history are separate.

## First steps

1. Update via the official client/store. PC players should close the game and restart the Hypergryph launcher.
2. Check mailbox eligibility. Maintenance and fix compensation grant 900 currency each, in two mails, only for characters created before the update after mailbox unlock. Both expire at the next version maintenance.
3. Check your current search phase before budgeting. Si and Minghe do not have simultaneous featured windows.
4. Follow story progress into Wuling — Si’s Painting; Chapter II Process VIII is added. Unlocks depend on progress.

## Dates use server time

| Item | Official window |
| --- | --- |
| Si featured search | After update–November 5, 11:59 |
| Minghe featured search | November 5, 12:00–version maintenance |
| Seven-day sign-in, five tickets | After update–November 5, 11:59 |
| Photo event | October 22, 12:00–November 5, 04:00 |
| Tangtang reconstruction search | October 29, 12:00–November 19, 11:59 |

Weapon claim periods count three special searches from their respective starting searches. Do not invent fixed end dates. Confirm rates and pity rules in the client.

## Revalidate older system guides

Automated planting unlocks first in the new area, with Wuling City access following story progression. Combo priorities can now be configured for simultaneous triggers. Equipment presets save named loadouts but do not establish an optimal build. Cabin shifts support A/B teams and automatic rotation, yet insufficient working hours may interrupt production. Expiring sanity items can still be destroyed when conversion caps or extractor availability block conversion; this is not an unconditional no-waste guarantee.

This guide summarizes an official notice, not client testing. Verify skill values, material efficiency, recipes and collection routes before using historical test advice. Continue to the [CN update board](/endfield/events).

## 対象と出典

[中国版10月15日更新告知](https://endfield.hypergryph.com/news/6094)を10月18日に確認。予定メンテナンスは06:00～12:00 UTC+8で、実際の終了時刻の証明ではありません。国際版とPioneer Test履歴は別扱いです。

1. 公式ストア・クライアントで更新。PCはゲームを閉じてランチャーを再起動します。
2. メール資格を確認。更新前作成のキャラクターがメール解放後に各900の補償2通を受取可能で、次回バージョンメンテナンス時に失効します。
3. 尋訪段階を確認。祀と明河のピックアップは同時ではありません。
4. 進行に応じて新エリア「武陵 - 祀の画」へ。第二章進程Ⅷまで追加されます。

## 日時はサーバー時刻

| 項目 | 告知期間 |
| --- | --- |
| 祀の尋訪 | 更新後～11月5日11:59 |
| 明河の尋訪 | 11月5日12:00～バージョンメンテナンス前 |

本ページは告知整理で、クライアント実測ではありません。技能倍率、素材効率、配方コスト、収集ルートは現行版で確認し、[中国版更新ボード](/endfield/events)へ進んでください。

## 历史资料与当前国服分流

本页旧测试资料不是当前国服结论。10月15日国服「丹青渡」更新已公布，请先看[当前版本与活动](/endfield/version)及[丹青渡官方更新整理](/endfield/guides/danqingdu-cn-update-guide)。其他地区另行核验；以下日期、报名和上线观察保留为历史。

## 当前状态：先分清已结束、可复用与待确认

Pioneer Test 招募已经结束。当前最有价值的不是继续寻找历史报名入口，而是把测试后信息分为三类：

- **已结束的测试事项**：资格、客户端下载窗口、测试奖励和历史反馈，只用于复盘或结算核对。
- **可复用的玩法资料**：AIC 工厂的模块化布局、Wuling 资源线、已有干员的职业分工和培养笔记。
- **待官方确认的未来信息**：下一轮测试、预下载、正式上线日期、平台开放和兑换码。没有官网、Steam、官方邮件或官方社区公告时，不把它们写成已开放。

## 15 分钟测试后检查表

1. **账号与奖励**：检查官方邮件、测试资格通知和结算说明；不要相信非官方截图中的奖励或代码。
2. **平台状态**：区分历史 Steam 测试与当前可下载状态；下载、预下载和移动端节奏都以官方页面为准。
3. **保存有效笔记**：保留 AIC 生产线的输入、输出、运输和瓶颈记录，而不是照搬整张旧地图布局。
4. **整理已有干员**：按职业、元素、武器与队伍职责标记已验证的培养方向；旧数值与 Tier 只能作为测试期参考。
5. **建立官方观察清单**：官网、Steam、官方社媒/社区和官方邮件是下一轮测试、预下载与兑换码的唯一确认来源。

## AIC 与 Wuling：把经验变成可复用模块

测试结束后，工厂资料最容易因为版本改动而失效。保存蓝图时建议：

| 模块 | 记录内容 | 目的 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 资源入口 | 原料、采集方式、运输方向 | 下次测试快速恢复资源线 |
| 中间产物 | 配方、机器数、缓存位置 | 找出真正瓶颈，避免整线返工 |
| 成品出口 | 用途、需求频率、升级预留 | 判断要扩线还是临时补产 |
| 电力与物流 | 接口、冗余、拥堵点 | 方便替换机器或改变地图位置 |

Wuling 资源路线和 AIC 布局应当按“小模块 + 清晰输入输出 + 可替换接口”保存。下一轮测试或正式版若调整配方、成本、机器和解锁条件，再用官方数据重算，而不是把旧蓝图当作最终答案。

## 干员、配队与养成：先投资已有资料

当没有新的官方版本公告时，优先处理已经有数据支撑的内容：

1. 在干员图鉴确认已有干员的职业、元素、武器和技能定位。
2. 在配队页先补队伍职责缺口，再决定谁需要优先升级。
3. 用配装页对照可获得武器与替代方案，不为未公布角色预留整套资源。
4. 旧测试期的 Tier、伤害公式、装备效果和材料成本都应标为参考，等待下一次官方测试或正式版验证。

## 官方状态观察：什么出现后才更新行动

| 官方信息出现 | 应该做什么 | 不该做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 下一轮测试公告 | 核对平台、地区、资格时间与规则 | 把转述日期当作报名开放 |
| 预下载公告 | 核对客户端来源、容量、系统要求与开放时间 | 使用第三方安装包或镜像 |
| 正式上线公告 | 核对平台、区服、账号与数据继承说明 | 把测试资料直接当成正式版结论 |
| 官方兑换码 | 到兑换码入口核对状态和有效期 | 输入社区传播的未验证字符串 |

## 推荐阅读顺序

1. [/endfield/events](/endfield/events)：看测试后行动、AIC 路线和官方确认状态。
2. [/endfield/guides/blueprint-aic-factory-guide](/endfield/guides/blueprint-aic-factory-guide)：整理蓝图与工厂模块。
3. [/endfield/characters](/endfield/characters)、[/endfield/teams](/endfield/teams) 与 [/endfield/build](/endfield/build)：复盘已有干员的队伍和养成。
4. [/endfield/download](/endfield/download)：只在官方测试或平台状态变化后核对下载与配置。

## 常见误区

- **把 Pioneer Test 当成正式上线**：测试资格或历史客户端不代表当前可玩。
- **把旧工厂图当成最终蓝图**：系统、配方和地图可能在下一次测试变动。
- **把社区截图当作代码或奖励凭证**：只采信官方来源和站内已核验状态。
- **为了未公布干员暂停现有养成**：先提高已有队伍与可复用工厂模块的完成度。

## Historical scope and current CN version

These older test notes are not current CN conclusions. See the [current version](/endfield/version) and [Danqingdu guide](/endfield/guides/danqingdu-cn-update-guide). Other regions need separate checks. Dates, access and release-watch wording below are historical.

## Current status: separate ended, reusable, and unconfirmed information

Pioneer Test recruitment has ended. The useful route is no longer an old application link. Separate post-test information into three groups:

- **Ended test items:** eligibility, client windows, test rewards, and historical feedback are for recap or settlement checks only.
- **Reusable gameplay notes:** modular AIC layouts, Wuling resource lines, and owned-operator role and build notes.
- **Future official-only information:** another test, preload, full release dates, platform availability, and redeem codes. Do not present these as open without an official site, Steam, official email, or official community notice.

## 15-minute post-test checklist

1. **Account and rewards:** Check official mail, eligibility notices, and settlement details. Do not trust rewards or codes from unofficial screenshots.
2. **Platform status:** Separate a historical Steam test from current download availability. Downloads, preload, and mobile timing follow official pages.
3. **Keep useful notes:** Preserve AIC line inputs, outputs, transport, and bottlenecks rather than copying an old full-map layout.
4. **Review owned operators:** Organize verified build directions by profession, element, weapon, and team duty. Older numbers and tiers are test references only.
5. **Keep an official watchlist:** Official site, Steam, official social/community posts, and official email are the only confirmation sources for another test, preload, or codes.

## AIC and Wuling: turn test learning into reusable modules

Factory details can change between tests. Record resource inputs, intermediate recipes and machine counts, product outputs, and power/logistics interfaces as small modules. Recalculate with official data if a future test or release changes recipes, costs, machines, or unlock requirements.

## Operators, teams, and builds

Without a new official version notice, invest in information with data behind it: confirm roles in the operator wiki, fill team-duty gaps, compare obtainable weapon alternatives, and keep older test tiers, formulas, gear effects, and material costs marked as references. Do not suspend owned-operator growth for unannounced characters.

## What turns watch items into actions

| Official notice | Do | Do not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Another test | Verify platform, region, eligibility window, and rules | Treat reposted dates as open recruitment |
| Preload | Verify client source, size, requirements, and opening time | Use third-party installers or mirrors |
| Full release | Verify platforms, servers, account, and carryover terms | Treat test material as final-release conclusions |
| Official code | Check status and validity at the code route | Enter unverified community strings |

## Read next

1. [/endfield/events](/endfield/events): post-test actions, AIC route, and official watch state.
2. [/endfield/guides/blueprint-aic-factory-guide](/endfield/guides/blueprint-aic-factory-guide): blueprint and factory modules.
3. [/endfield/characters](/endfield/characters), [/endfield/teams](/endfield/teams), and [/endfield/build](/endfield/build): owned-operator teams and builds.
4. [/endfield/download](/endfield/download): verify download and specs only after an official platform status changes.

content:
## 欢迎，博士

你已抵达塔拉二号，这个被天灾和源石虫侵袭的边境开拓地。作为罗德岛的驻派博士，你需要带领干员们在这里建立据点、探索未知。

### 基础操作

- **基地建设**: 建造和升级各类设施，生产资源
- **即时战斗**: 指挥干员进行实时战斗，合理分配部署费用
- **探索开采**: 在开放世界中采集资源、发现秘境

### 干员职业系统

每个干员拥有独特的职业和战斗风格：

1. **先锋 (Vanguard)** — 快速展开，获取部署费用
2. **近卫 (Guard)** — 近战输出主力
3. **重装 (Defender)** — 防御和坦克
4. **狙击 (Striker)** — 远程元素输出
5. **术师 (Caster)** — 元素输出
6. **辅助 (Supporter)** — 团队增益与治疗

### 养成优先级

1. 先提升主C干员等级和技能
2. 获取适配的武器
3. 完成开拓任务获取材料
4. 最后考虑副C和辅助的养成
contentEn:
## Welcome, Doctor

You've arrived at Talos II, a frontier development zone ravaged by Catastrophes and Originium creatures. As a dispatched Doctor from Rhodes Island, you must lead operators to establish bases and explore the unknown.

### Basic Controls

- **Base Building**: Construct and upgrade facilities, produce resources
- **Real-time Combat**: Command operators in real-time battles, manage Deployment Points (DP)
- **Open World Exploration**: Gather resources, discover secret areas

### Operator Profession System

Each operator has a unique profession and combat style:

1. **Vanguard** — Rapid deployment, DP generation
2. **Guard** — Melee DPS mainstay
3. **Defender** — Defense and tanking
4. **Striker** — Ranged elemental DPS
5. **Caster** — Elemental DPS
6. **Supporter** — Team buffs and healing

### Progression Priority

1. Level up your main DPS and skills first
2. Obtain suitable weapons
3. Complete development tasks for materials
4. Then invest in sub-DPS and supports

content:
## 战斗系统概述

终末地采用即时战斗系统，区别于原作的塔防模式。玩家需要在开放世界中实时操控干员进行战斗。

### 部署费用 (DP) 系统

- 每个干员的技能消耗DP
- DP随时间自动恢复
- 先锋干员可以加速DP获取
- 合理分配DP是战斗的关键

### 干员切换

- 战斗中可随时切换4名干员
- 切换时有短暂无敌帧
- 不同干员之间可以触发连锁技能

### Boss战策略

1. 先用先锋积攒DP
2. 切换到主C输出
3. 注意Boss的攻击模式，及时切换到坦克
4. 在Boss虚弱期全力输出
contentEn:
## Combat Overview

Endfield features a real-time combat system, different from the original's tower defense. Players directly control operators in open-world battles.

### Deployment Points (DP) System

- Each operator's skill costs DP
- DP regenerates over time
- Vanguard operators accelerate DP generation
- Proper DP allocation is key to combat

### Operator Switching

- Switch between 4 operators freely in combat
- Brief invincibility frames during switch
- Different operators can trigger chain skills

### Boss Fight Strategy

1. Start with Vanguard to build DP
2. Switch to main DPS for damage
3. Watch boss attack patterns, switch to tank when needed
4. Full damage during boss vulnerability windows

faq.question: How does the DP system work in Endfield?
faq.questionZh: 终末地的DP系统怎么运作？
faq.answer: DP (Deployment Points) are consumed when using skills. They regenerate over time and can be accelerated by Vanguard operators.
faq.answerZh: DP（部署费用）在使用技能时消耗，会随时间自动恢复，先锋干员可以加速获取。

title: 《明日方舟：终末地》元素与反应机制详解
titleEn: Arknights: Endfield Elements & Arts Reactions — Complete Guide
summary: 深入解析终末地的5大元素属性（Physical、Heat、Cryo、Nature、Electric）和4种Arts Reaction（Combustion、Electrification、Solidification、Corrosion）机制。
summaryEn: Complete guide to Endfield's 5 elements (Physical, Heat, Cryo, Nature, Electric) and 4 Arts Reactions (Combustion, Electrification, Solidification, Corrosion).
content:
## 元素与反应系统概述

终末地有5种元素属性，每个干员拥有特定元素，决定其伤害类型和可触发的反应。

### 5大元素

1. **Physical (物理)** — 白色伤害，Guard/Defender为主，可造成Crush、Breach等物理状态
2. **Heat (热能)** — 红色伤害，可施加Heat Infliction，触发Combustion反应
3. **Cryo (冷冻)** — 青色伤害，可施加Cryo Infliction，触发Solidification反应
4. **Nature (自然)** — 绿色伤害，可施加Nature Infliction，触发Corrosion反应
5. **Electric (电击)** — 黄色伤害，可施加Electric Infliction，触发Electrification反应

### Arts Reaction 触发规则

当施加一种元素的Infliction给已有不同元素Infliction的敌人时，两种Infliction被消耗，触发Arts Reaction：

- **叠加元素**（第一个施加的）决定反应的强度/Status Level
- **触发元素**（第二个施加的）决定反应的类型和元素伤害属性

### 4种Arts Reaction

| 反应 | 触发条件 | 效果 |
|------|---------|------|
| Combustion (燃烧) | Heat + 非Heat | Heat DMG + 持续Heat DOT 10秒 |
| Electrification (感电) | Electric + 非Electric | Electric DMG + 增加受到的Arts DMG |
| Solidification (凝固) | Cryo + 非Cryo | Cryo DMG + 冻结敌人，可被Shatter消耗 |
| Corrosion (腐蚀) | Nature + 非Nature | Nature DMG + 降低抗性 15秒 |

### Physical Status 系统

Physical元素独特之处在于Vulnerable机制：
- 首次对敌人施加Physical Status时，产生Vulnerable（破盾）
- 被Lift或Knock Down的Vulnerable敌人可叠加Vulnerable层数（最多4层）
- 使用Crush或Breach攻击会消耗Vulnerable层数造成额外伤害

### Shatter 反应

当对处于Solidification状态的敌人施加Vulnerable或Physical Status时：
- 消耗Solidification
- 造成大量Physical DMG

### 配队建议

- 双元素配队：选择两种元素以触发特定Reaction
- 热门组合：Heat + Nature（Laevatain），Cryo + Physical（Shatter流）
- 三元素配队：更具灵活性但需要更多DP管理
contentEn:
## Elements & Reactions Overview

Endfield features 5 elements. Each operator has a specific element that determines their damage type and available reactions.

### 5 Elements

1. **Physical** — White damage numbers. Primarily Guards and Defenders. Can inflict Crush, Breach, and other Physical Statuses.
2. **Heat** — Red damage numbers. Applies Heat Infliction, triggers Combustion reaction.
3. **Cryo** — Cyan damage numbers. Applies Cryo Infliction, triggers Solidification reaction.
4. **Nature** — Green damage numbers. Applies Nature Infliction, triggers Corrosion reaction.
5. **Electric** — Yellow damage numbers. Applies Electric Infliction, triggers Electrification reaction.

### Arts Reaction Trigger Rules

When applying an element's Infliction to an enemy already affected by a different element's Infliction, both are consumed to trigger an Arts Reaction:

- **Stacking Element** (applied first) determines the reaction's strength/Status Level
- **Triggering Element** (applied second) determines the reaction type and elemental damage

### 4 Arts Reactions

| Reaction | Trigger | Effect |
|----------|---------|--------|
| Combustion | Heat + Non-Heat | Heat DMG + Heat DOT for 10s |
| Electrification | Electric + Non-Electric | Electric DMG + Increased Arts DMG Taken |
| Solidification | Cryo + Non-Cryo | Cryo DMG + Freezes enemy, consumable by Shatter |
| Corrosion | Nature + Non-Nature | Nature DMG + Reduced resistance for 15s |

### Physical Status System

Physical element has a unique Vulnerable mechanic:
- First Physical Status application inflicts Vulnerable (broken shield)
- Vulnerable enemies can be Lifted or Knocked Down to add Vulnerable stacks (up to 4)
- Using Crush or Breach consumes Vulnerable stacks for extra damage

### Shatter Reaction

When applying Vulnerable or a Physical Status to a Solidified enemy:
- Consumes Solidification
- Deals massive Physical DMG

### Team Building Tips

- Dual-element teams: Choose two elements for specific Reactions
- Popular combos: Heat + Nature (Laevatain), Cryo + Physical (Shatter)
- Triple-element teams: More flexibility but harder DP management

content:
## 伤害类型

终末地有以下伤害类型：
- **Physical DMG** — 白色数字，受DEF减免
- **Heat DMG** — 红色数字
- **Cryo DMG** — 青色数字
- **Nature DMG** — 绿色数字
- **Electric DMG** — 黄色数字
- **Arts DMG** — 元素伤害的统称

## 核心属性

### 6大基础属性

| 属性 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| HP | 生命值 |
| ATK | 攻击力，影响所有伤害 |
| STR (Strength) | 影响Physical DMG和DEF |
| AGL (Agility) | 影响CRIT Rate和闪避 |
| INT (Intellect) | 影响Arts DMG |
| WIL (Will) | 影响Treatment效果和Ultimate增益 |

### 关键二级属性

- **CRIT Rate** — 基础5%，受AGL和装备影响
- **CRIT DMG** — 暴击伤害倍率
- **Arts Intensity** — 每点增加1% Arts DMG
- **Stagger Efficiency** — 影响失衡效果
- **DMG Reduction** — 伤害减免

## Arts Reaction 伤害计算

### 初始基础Arts DMG

触发Arts Reaction时的初始伤害受以下因素影响：

1. **等级倍率**: `(195 + 角色等级) / 196` — 每级约增加0.51%
2. **Arts Intensity倍率**: `(100 + Arts Intensity) / 100` — 每点AI增加1%

### 公式

`最终伤害 = 基础Arts DMG × 等级倍率 × Arts Intensity倍率 × 抗性系数 × 增伤系数`

### Combustion DOT

燃烧反应每秒造成Heat DMG，持续10秒，伤害量受Status Level影响。

## 提升伤害的方法

1. **提升ATK** — 基础乘区
2. **提升对应属性** — STR(Physical) / INT(Arts) 专属乘区
3. **Arts Intensity** — Arts DMG独立乘区
4. **CRIT Rate/DMG** — 暴击乘区
5. **Arts Reaction** — 反应乘区
6. **装备套装效果** — 各种专属加成
7. **降低敌人抗性** — Corrosion等debuff
contentEn:
## Damage Types

Endfield features the following damage types:
- **Physical DMG** — White numbers, reduced by DEF
- **Heat DMG** — Red numbers
- **Cryo DMG** — Cyan numbers
- **Nature DMG** — Green numbers
- **Electric DMG** — Yellow numbers
- **Arts DMG** — Collective term for elemental damage

## Core Stats

### 6 Base Stats

| Stat | Role |
|------|------|
| HP | Health Points |
| ATK | Attack Power, affects all damage |
| STR (Strength) | Affects Physical DMG and DEF |
| AGL (Agility) | Affects CRIT Rate and evasion |
| INT (Intellect) | Affects Arts DMG |
| WIL (Will) | Affects Treatment and Ultimate增益 |

### Key Secondary Stats

- **CRIT Rate** — Base 5%, affected by AGL and gear
- **CRIT DMG** — Critical damage multiplier
- **Arts Intensity** — Each point increases Arts DMG by 1%
- **Stagger Efficiency** — Affects stagger effects
- **DMG Reduction** — Reduces incoming damage

## Arts Reaction Damage Calculation

### Initial Base Arts DMG

The initial damage from triggering an Arts Reaction is affected by:

1. **Level Multiplier**: `(195 + Operator Level) / 196` — ~0.51% per level
2. **Arts Intensity Multiplier**: `(100 + Arts Intensity) / 100` — +1% per AI point

### Formula

`Final DMG = Base Arts DMG × Level Multiplier × Arts Intensity Multiplier × Resistance Factor × DMG Bonus Factor`

### Combustion DOT

Combustion deals Heat DMG per second for 10s. Damage amount scales with Status Level.

## Ways to Increase Damage

1. **Increase ATK** — Base multiplier
2. **Increase relevant stat** — STR (Physical) / INT (Arts) dedicated multiplier
3. **Arts Intensity** — Independent Arts DMG multiplier
4. **CRIT Rate/DMG** — Critical multiplier
5. **Arts Reactions** — Reaction multiplier
6. **Gear Set effects** — Various dedicated bonuses
7. **Reduce enemy resistance** — Corrosion and other debuffs

## 装备系统概述

每个干员可装备4件装备：1件Armor、1双Gloves、2个Kit。装备提供DEF和多种属性加成。

### 装备制作

在Gear Assembly菜单中使用Component材料和Stock Bills制作。大多数配方通过Authority Level解锁。

### 装备等级与材料

## 套装效果一览

### SS级套装

1. **Æthertech (源石技艺)** — ATK+8%，施加Vulnerable后Physical DMG+8%/层(4层)，满4层Vulnerable时额外+16%
2. **Bonekrusha (碎骨者)** — ATK+15%，连携技后下一次战技DMG+30%(2层)
3. **Pulser Labs (脉冲实验室)** — Arts Intensity+30，Electric/Cryo DMG+50%
4. **Hot Work (热工)** — Arts Intensity+30，Heat/Nature DMG+50%
5. **Xiranflow (锡兰流)** — ATK+10%，消耗Electric/Nature反应后DMG+15%/层(3层)
6. **Grizzled Edge (苍刃)** — ATK+8%，Crush/Breach时Physical DMG+[6%×Vulnerable层数]

### S级套装

- **Aburrey's Legacy** — Skill DMG+24%，三技能类型独立ATK+5%
- **LYNX** — 治疗+20%，目标获得15-30% DMG Reduction
- **Swordmancer** — Stagger+20%，Physical Status额外250%ATK伤害
- **Frontiers** — 连携CDR+15%，SP回复后全队DMG+16%
- **MI Security** — CRIT+5%，暴击后ATK+5%(5层)，满层额外CRIT+5%
- **Type 50 Yinglung** — ATK+15%，队友战技触发连携技DMG+20%(3层)

## Artificing 精炼系统

解锁条件：完成Wuling City的Gear Artificing任务。

- 消耗一件金色装备和对应的Artificing Catalyst
- 每个属性最多成功精炼3次（共9次）
- 使用高基础值材料（Good Match）提高成功率
- 失败会增加精炼进度，进度满后下次必定成功

| Guard (物理) | Æthertech / Grizzled Edge / Swordmancer |
| Guard (元素) | Tide Surge / Aburrey's Legacy |

| Supporter | LYNX / Eternal Xiranite / Frontiers |
| Defender | Armored MSGR / Eternal Xiranite |
| Vanguard | Æthertech / Roving MSGR / Frontiers |
contentEn:
## Gear System Overview

Each operator can equip 4 gear pieces: 1 Armor, 1 pair of Gloves, and 2 Kits. Gear provides DEF and various stat bonuses.

### Gear Crafting

Craft gear in the Gear Assembly menu using Component materials and Stock Bills. Most recipes unlock through Authority Levels.

### Gear Levels & Costs

| Level | Cost |
|-------|------|
| 10 | Wood x2, Origocrust x10 |
| 20 | Amethyst Component x5, Valley Stock Bill x30 |
| 28 | Amethyst Component x20, Valley Stock Bill x160 |
| 36 | Ferrium Component x50, Valley Stock Bill x1200 |
| 50 | Cryston Component x50, Valley Stock Bill x9600 |
| 70 | Xiranite/Cuprium/Hetonite Component x50, Wuling Stock Bill x8000-25000 |

## Gear Set Effects

### SS-Tier Sets

1. **Æthertech** — ATK +8%, Physical DMG +8%/stack (4 stacks) on Vulnerability application. Extra +16% at 4 Vulnerability stacks.
2. **Bonekrusha** — ATK +15%, next battle skill DMG +30% after combo skill (2 stacks).
3. **Pulser Labs** — Arts Intensity +30, Electric/Cryo DMG +50%.
4. **Hot Work** — Arts Intensity +30, Heat/Nature DMG +50%.
5. **Xiranflow** — ATK +10%, Electric/Nature DMG +15%/stack (3 stacks) on reaction consumption.
6. **Grizzled Edge** — ATK +8%, Physical DMG +[6% × Vulnerable stacks consumed] on Crush/Breach.

### S-Tier Sets

- **Aburrey's Legacy** — Skill DMG +24%, independent ATK +5% from each skill type.
- **LYNX** — Treatment +20%, targets gain 15-30% DMG Reduction.
- **Swordmancer** — Stagger +20%, Physical Status triggers 250% ATK bonus hit.
- **Frontiers** — Combo CDR +15%, team DMG +16% on SP recovery.
- **MI Security** — CRIT +5%, ATK +5% on crit (5 stacks), extra CRIT +5% at max.
- **Type 50 Yinglung** — ATK +15%, combo DMG +20%/stack (3 stacks) from team skills.
- **Eternal Xiranite** — HP +1000, teammates DMG +16% on debuff application.
- **Qingbo** — Combo CDR +15%, Skill DMG +20%/stack (2 stacks) on combo.
- **Tide Surge** — Skill DMG +20%, Arts DMG +35% with 2+ Arts Infliction stacks.

## Artificing System

Unlocked by completing the Gear Artificing mission in Wuling City.

- Costs one gold-quality gear + matching Artificing Catalyst
- Each stat can be successfully upgraded up to 3 times (9 total per piece)
- Higher base value material (Good Match) increases success rate
- Failed attempts add Artificing Progress; full progress guarantees next success

## Recommended Sets by Class

| Class | Recommended Sets |
|-------|-----------------|
| Guard (Physical) | Æthertech / Grizzled Edge / Swordmancer |
| Guard (Elemental) | Tide Surge / Aburrey's Legacy |
| Striker | Bonekrusha / Type 50 Yinglung / Qingbo |
| Caster (Heat/Nature) | Hot Work / Xiranflow |
| Caster (Electric/Cryo) | Pulser Labs |
| Supporter | LYNX / Eternal Xiranite / Frontiers |
| Defender | Armored MSGR / Eternal Xiranite |
| Vanguard | Æthertech / Roving MSGR / Frontiers |

summaryEn: Endfield team composition guide: elemental reaction teams, physical Shatter teams, mono-element teams, and mode-specific adjustments.
content:
## 阵伍构建基础

终末地通常使用4-6名干员的战斗编队，核心思路：

1. **主C** — 核心输出，资源优先投入
2. **副C** — 补充伤害，触发元素反应
3. **辅助** — 增益/减抗/控制
4. **生存** — 治疗/护盾/坦克
5. **先锋** — 快速展开，获取DP

## 推荐阵容

### 1. 碎冰队（Cryo + Physical）

| 位置 | 干员 | 作用 |
|------|------|------|
| 主C | 物理近卫 | 利用Shatter反应打爆发 |
| 副C | Cryo术师 | 施加Solidification |
| 辅助 | Nature辅助 | 减抗 |
| 生存 | Defender | 前排抗压 |

**思路**：Cryo干员先施加Solidification冻结敌人，物理干员触发Shatter造成大量物理伤害。

### 2. 燃烧队（Heat + Nature）

| 位置 | 干员 | 作用 |
|------|------|------|
| 主C | Heat狙击 | 持续燃烧输出 |
| 副C | Laevatain | 触发Combustion |
| 辅助 | Electric辅助 | 触发Electrification |
| 生存 | 治疗 | 续航 |

**思路**：Heat + Nature触发Combustion持续伤害，配合Electrification增伤。

### 3. 快速展开队

- 多先锋开局快速获取DP
- 尽早部署主C和辅助
- 适合需要快速应对的关卡

## DP管理技巧

- 先锋优先部署，确保DP产出
- 高费用干员留到中期部署
- 注意撤退回收DP（部分干员）
contentEn:
## Team Building Basics

Endfield uses 4-6 operator combat squads. Core structure:

1. **Main DPS** — Primary damage, priority investment
2. **Sub-DPS** — Supplemental damage, elemental reactions
3. **Support** — Buffs/debuffs/control
4. **Survival** — Healing/shield/tank
5. **Vanguard** — Fast deployment, DP generation

## Recommended Teams

### 1. Shatter Team (Cryo + Physical)

| Position | Operator | Role |
|----------|----------|------|
| DPS | Physical Guard | Exploits Shatter reaction |
| Sub-DPS | Cryo Caster | Applies Solidification |
| Support | Nature Support | Resistance down |
| Survival | Defender | Frontline |

**Strategy**: Cryo operator applies Solidification to freeze enemies, Physical operator triggers Shatter for massive damage.

### 2. Combustion Team (Heat + Nature)

| Position | Operator | Role |
|----------|----------|------|
| DPS | Heat Striker | Sustained burn damage |
| Sub-DPS | Laevatain | Triggers Combustion |
| Support | Electric Support | Triggers Electrification |
| Survival | Healer | Sustain |

**Strategy**: Heat + Nature triggers Combustion DoT, combined with Electrification for increased Arts DMG.

### 3. Rush Deployment Team

- Multiple Vanguards for early DP
- Deploy main DPS and supports quickly
- Best for stages requiring fast response

## DP Management

- Deploy Vanguards first for DP generation
- Save high-cost operators for mid-game
- Retreat operators to refund DP when possible

## 干员养成

### 等级与精英化

- 干员等级上限受精英化阶段限制
- 每50级需要精英化突破
- 精英化材料从主线和活动获取

| 优先级 | 内容 |

### 潜能系统

- 重复获取干员提升潜能
- 潜能降低部署费用和再部署时间
- 非必需，但对高难关卡有帮助

## 基地发展优先级

### 第一阶段（前期）
1. 制造站 — 生产基础材料
2. 经验本 — 快速提升干员等级
3. 交易所 — 金币来源

### 第二阶段（中期）
1. 精英化材料本 — 突破瓶颈
2. 技能本 — 技能升级
3. 装备本 — 提升战力

### 第三阶段（后期）
1. 高级装备本
2. 挑战副本
3. 基地全升级

### Level & Promotion

- Level cap is determined by promotion stage
- Promotion required every ~50 levels
- Promotion materials from main story and events

### Skill Upgrades

| Priority | Target |

| 1 | Main DPS core skill → Max |
| 2 | Support buff skill → Lv 7 |
| 3 | Sub-DPS skill → Lv 7 |
| 4 | Survival skill → Lv 5 |

### Potential System

- Duplicates increase Potential
- Potential reduces DP cost and redeploy time
- Not required but helpful for hard stages

## Base Development Priority

### Phase 1 (Early)
1. Factory — Basic material production
2. EXP Dungeon — Fast operator leveling
3. Trade Station — Gold income

### Phase 2 (Mid)
1. Promotion Material Dungeon — Breakthrough
2. Skill Dungeon — Skill upgrades
3. Gear Dungeon — Combat power

### Phase 3 (Late)
1. Advanced Gear Dungeon
2. Challenge Stages
3. Full base upgrades

| Phase | Priority |

| Mid | Skill 40%, Gear 30%, Breakthrough 20%, Gold 10% |
| Late | Gear 50%, Skill 30%, Advanced Materials 20% |

content:
## 终局内容概览

终末地的终局玩法主要包括：

1. **高难挑战副本** — 需要满配阵容和策略
2. **深层探索** — 多层Rougelike模式
3. **限时活动** — 高难EX关卡
4. **Boss歼灭战** — 特殊机制Boss

## 高难挑战副本

### 阵容要求
- 全员满级+精英化
- 核心技能满级
- 金色装备+精炼

### 通用策略
1. 先观察Boss机制和弱点
2. 搭配属性克制队伍
3. 合理分配DP，优先部署生存位
4. 保留终结技用于关键阶段

## 深层探索（Rougelike）

- 每层选择增益效果
- 资源有限，需要取舍
- 推荐携带泛用性高的干员
- 随机事件可能改变路线

### 推荐干员
- 生存能力强的Guard/Defender
- 自带治疗的干员
- AOE伤害优秀的术师/狙击

## Boss歼灭战

### Boss机制要点
- Boss通常有多阶段
- 注意狂暴倒计时
- 部分Boss需要特定元素反应才能有效破盾
- 优先清理召唤的小怪

### 推荐阵容
| Boss类型 | 推荐元素 | 备注 |
|----------|----------|------|
| 护盾型 | Cryo+Physical | Shatter快速破盾 |
| 高血量型 | Heat+Nature | Combustion持续伤害 |
| 多目标 | Electric | Chain AoE |

## 评分提升技巧

- 快速通关 → 时间加分
- 低战力通关 → 效率加分
- 不损失干员 → 完美加分
contentEn:
## Endgame Content Overview

Endfield's endgame includes:

1. **High-Difficulty Challenges** — Requires fully built teams
2. **Deep Exploration** — Multi-floor roguelike mode
3. **Limited Events** — EX stages
4. **Boss Annihilation** — Special mechanic bosses

## High-Difficulty Dungeons

### Requirements
- All operators max level + promoted
- Core skills maxed
- Gold gear + refined

### General Strategy
1. Study boss mechanics and weaknesses
2. Build attribute advantage team
3. Manage DP, deploy survival first
4. Save ultimates for critical phases

## Deep Exploration (Roguelike)

- Choose buffs each floor
- Limited resources, prioritize wisely
- Bring versatile operators
- Random events may alter your path

### Recommended Operators
- High-survival Guards/Defenders
- Self-healing operators
- Strong AoE Casters/Strikers

## Boss Annihilation

### Key Mechanics
- Bosses have multiple phases
- Watch enrage timers
- Some bosses need specific reactions to break shields
- Clear summoned minions first

### Team Recommendations
| Boss Type | Recommended Elements | Notes |
|-----------|---------------------|-------|
| Shielded | Cryo + Physical | Shatter for fast shield break |
| High HP | Heat + Nature | Combustion DoT |
| Multi-target | Electric | Chain AoE |

## Score Optimization

- Fast clear → Time bonus
- Low power clear → Efficiency bonus
- No operator loss → Perfect bonus

## 危机合约·重燃测试作战攻略

「危机合约·重燃测试」是终末地最新高难度挑战活动，提供 40-45 星难度层级，需要合理的干员搭配和指标组合。

- **核心**: 选择指标组合提升难度，通过策略搭配通关

**指标组合**：
- 选择降低输出但不影响生存的指标
- 保持埃特拉坦度足够扛住所有攻击
- 利用高台位和卡位减少受伤

**打法要点**：

Homecoming 之后，终末地的高意图搜索明显从“什么时候更新”转到“蓝图怎么用、AIC 工厂怎么搭、生产线怎么更省事”。这类用户通常不是想读新闻，而是想马上把基地效率提起来。

### 蓝图 / AIC 先解决什么

- **蓝图**：解决重复搭建、布局复用和生产线迁移的问题。
- **AIC 工厂**：解决材料加工、配方衔接、机器布局和自动化的问题。
- **Homecoming QoL**：重点关注新增物料状态、更多配方、机器和生产线调整。
- **回流玩家**：先恢复基础产能，再追新地图和新干员养成。

## 新手的 AIC 工厂顺序

1. **先保基础材料**：优先能稳定供给升级、装备和干员养成的材料。
2. **再做单线闭环**：不要一开始铺太大，先做一条可理解、可维护的生产线。
3. **最后再复制蓝图**：等路线稳定后再保存蓝图，避免把低效布局复制到全基地。

### 第一条生产线建议

| 阶段 | 目标 | 判断标准 |
|---|---|---|
| 起步 | 能持续产基础材料 | 不需要频繁手动补缺口 |
| 扩展 | 能支撑装备和干员养成 | 日常材料不再卡主线 |
| 优化 | 能用蓝图复制稳定模块 | 新区建设不需要重搭一次 |

## 回流玩家先别重建整个基地

回流玩家最常犯的错是看到 Homecoming 新系统后直接拆家。更稳的路线是：

1. 先标记旧生产线还能用的模块。
2. 把瓶颈材料、断线机器和低效搬运点列出来。
3. 只改瓶颈处，再保存新蓝图。
4. 等新地图材料需求明确后，再决定是否大规模迁移。

## 蓝图复用的 4 个原则

- **小模块优先**：保存 1 条生产线或 1 个功能区，比保存整个基地更灵活。
- **入口出口清楚**：蓝图里要能一眼看出材料从哪里进、成品从哪里出。
- **留升级空间**：机器、配方和物流以后会变，别把空间塞死。
- **按用途命名**：例如“基础材料线”“装备材料线”“新地图采集处理线”。

- 想理解战斗和干员搭配：接 /endfield/guides/combat-system-guide 与 /endfield/characters。

| 问题 | 可能原因 | 先做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 生产线停住 | 前置材料不足或机器断线 | 从最终产物倒推缺口 |
| 蓝图不好复用 | 模块太大或依赖太多 | 拆成小型功能模块 |
| 回流后看不懂基地 | 旧布局没有命名 | 先做区域标记再改造 |
| 新地图材料卡住 | 没有独立处理线 | 建一条新材料缓冲线 |

## Historical scope and current CN version

These older test notes are not current CN conclusions. See the [current version](/endfield/version) and [Danqingdu guide](/endfield/guides/danqingdu-cn-update-guide). Other regions need separate checks. Dates, access and release-watch wording below are historical.

## Quick answer

After Homecoming, high-intent Endfield searches shifted from "when is the update" to "how do blueprints work, how should I build the AIC factory, and how do I make production lines less painful." These users usually want a practical build route, not news.

### What blueprints / AIC solve

- **Blueprints**: Repeated builds, layout reuse, and production-line migration.
- **AIC factory**: Material processing, recipe chains, machine layout, and automation.
- **Homecoming QoL**: New material states, recipes, machines, and production-line improvements.
- **Returners**: Restore core output first, then chase new maps and operator progression.

## Beginner AIC factory order

1. **Secure basic materials**: Prioritize materials used for upgrades, gear, and operator progression.
2. **Build one closed loop**: Do not overbuild. Start with one understandable, maintainable line.
3. **Save blueprints after it works**: Stabilize the route before copying it across your base.

### First production line

| Stage | Goal | Success check |
|---|---|---|
| Start | Stable basic materials | Few manual supply gaps |
| Expand | Support gear and operators | Dailies no longer block progression |
| Optimize | Reuse stable modules as blueprints | New areas do not require rebuilding from scratch |

## Returners should not rebuild everything first

A common returner mistake is tearing down the whole base after seeing new Homecoming systems. A safer route:

1. Mark old production modules that still work.
2. List bottleneck materials, disconnected machines, and weak transport points.
3. Fix bottlenecks only, then save updated blueprints.
4. Wait until new-map material needs are clear before large migration.

## Four blueprint reuse rules

- **Small modules first**: One line or one function zone is more flexible than a full-base blueprint.
- **Clear input and output**: You should see where materials enter and products exit.
- **Leave upgrade space**: Machines, recipes, and logistics can change.
- **Name by purpose**: Examples: basic-material line, gear-material line, new-map processing line.

## How this connects to Homecoming

- New maps, Arcane / Liino, and rewards: /endfield/version.
- Base and production-line efficiency: this guide.
- Combat and operators: /endfield/guides/combat-system-guide and /endfield/characters.

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Likely cause | First action |
|---|---|---|
| Line stops | Missing inputs or disconnected machines | Trace backward from final output |
| Blueprint is hard to reuse | Module is too large or dependency-heavy | Split into smaller function modules |
| Returner base is confusing | Old layout has no names | Label zones before rebuilding |
| New-map material bottleneck | No dedicated processing line | Build a buffer line for new materials |
